create_QLearner: create a QLearner instance with a MAC, scheme, logger, and args for multi-agent Q-learning
train_QLearner: train the QLearner on an EpisodeBatch to compute TD-error and update agent and mixer weights
update_targets_QLearner: update the target MAC and target mixer networks by copying weights from the live networks
save_models_QLearner: save the MAC models, mixer state dict, and optimiser state to a given file path
load_models_QLearner: load the MAC models, mixer state dict, and optimiser state from a given file path
